cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Composes and signs a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0 with an eddsa-jcs-2022 Data Integrity proof over a fresh ephemeral did:key (generated per call, not reused). Returns the signed credential, an OCG Standard §23 vc-2.0 input-attestation block ready to embed in a ChainGraph chain's policy_parameters at the given pointer, and an OCG receipt of the issuance activity. The signature proves the claims were not altered after signing and that the did:key holder produced it -- it is not, by itself, identity assurance.

claims.description: Claim key-value pairs for credentialSubject (required, at least one entry).

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer where the attestation's claims sit in a consuming chain's policy_parameters. Default: "/subject_claims".

subject_id.description: Credential subject id (DID or any identifier string). Default: "did:example:subject".

name: vc_issue
title: Issue a signed W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0
